title: Unit 4: In the City: Places in Town & There is / There are
objective: Mampu berbicara tentang tempat-tempat di kota, memberikan petunjuk arah, dan berbelanja menggunakan struktur 'there is / there are' serta kata kerja imperatif

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menyebutkan tempat-tempat di kota (bank, museum, toko, restoran), menjelaskan keberadaan sesuatu menggunakan 'there is / there are', memberikan petunjuk arah dengan kata kerja imperatif (turn, go, don't open), serta berbelanja dengan angka 100+.
rules: There is + kata benda tunggal (singular noun): There is a park called Window of the World. / There is a museum in your town?
There are + kata benda jamak (plural noun): There are six bridges in the city. / There are some restaurants in the park.
Some / any: Gunakan 'some' dalam kalimat positif, gunakan 'any' dalam kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan: There aren't any people living in the park. / Are there any fun activities?
Imperative (kata kerja perintah): Gunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja tanpa 'to' untuk memberi perintah: Turn right. Go down the street. Don't open the door.
Prepositions of place: behind (di belakang), between (di antara), in front of (di depan), next to (di sebelah), opposite (di seberang): The bank is opposite the library.

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa membedakan 'there is' untuk singular dan 'there are' untuk plural, atau menggunakan 'some' di kalimat negatif padahal seharusnya 'any'.
commonTrap.wrong: There is many parks in London. / There are some people? / There aren't some shops here.
commonTrap.correct: There are many parks in London. / Are there any people? / There aren't any shops here.

vocab.collocation: There is a park called Window of the World.
Is there a museum in your town?
There are some restaurants and cafés in the park.
There is a train station in the park.
You buy milk in a supermarket.
The bank is opposite the library.
You send letters in a post office.
You buy medicine in a chemist's.

dialogue.context: Dua orang sedang berbelanja di toko buku dan mendiskusikan harga tiket kereta ke London

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Yes, please. A ticket to London, please. Return?
lines.translation: Ya, tolong. Satu tiket ke London. Pulang pergi?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, please – a day return. Is it?
lines.translation: Ya – tiket pulang pergi satu hari. Itu saja?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Well, it's £27.50 – but you can't come back between four o'clock and seven o'clock.
lines.translation: Nah, harganya £27.50 – tapi Anda tidak bisa pulang antara jam empat dan jam tujuh.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, no problem. Here you are – thirty pounds.
lines.translation: Oh, tidak masalah. Ini dia – tiga puluh pound.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Thank you. And … two pounds fifty change.
lines.translation: Terima kasih. Dan… kembalian dua pound lima puluh.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih memberikan petunjuk arah dan menjelaskan tempat-tempat di kota bersama tutor Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's practice giving directions. Imagine you're at the restaurant on the map. Can you tell me how to get to the supermarket?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: OK, turn right and go down King Street. The supermarket is on the right.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! That's very clear. Now, can you tell me: are there any parks near the supermarket?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, there is. There is a park next to the supermarket on Green Street.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! You're doing great. One more question: Is there a library in your town? Where is it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, there is. The library is opposite the restaurant, behind the bank.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: '_____ a museum in your town?'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'Is there' untuk membentuk pertanyaan dengan kata benda tunggal (a museum). Struktur: Is there + singular noun?

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: There are six bridges in the city.
There is six bridges in the city.
There are a bridge in the city.
quiz.answer: There are six bridges in the city.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'There are' untuk kata benda jamak (bridges). 'Six bridges' adalah bentuk jamak, jadi harus menggunakan 'are'.

quiz.question: Complete: 'There aren't _____ shops in this street.'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'any' dalam kalimat negatif dengan kata benda jamak. 'Some' hanya digunakan dalam kalimat positif.

quiz.question: Which is the correct imperative form?
options: To turn right into High Street.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk imperatif menggunakan kata kerja dasar tanpa 'to' atau '-ing'. Cukup: Turn right.

quiz.question: Where do you buy medicine?
quiz.explanation: Chemist's adalah apotek dalam bahasa Inggris British. Anda membeli obat di apotek, bukan di perpustakaan atau museum.

quiz.question: Complete: 'The bank is _____ the library.'
quiz.explanation: 'Opposite' berarti 'di seberang'. Preposisi ini digunakan untuk menunjukkan posisi berhadapan dengan sesuatu.
